title: Independent audit: confirm κ of #699 (0.001660666354374641) and #685 (0.001660339298410333)
body:
Independent finite audit of the two newest κ-record PRs by **Rohan Guliani (@Rohansguliani)**. Both submitted κ values are **confirmed exactly**. No mathematical, owner-map or arithmetic error was found. This PR does not change the selected bound.

| PR | Reviewed head | Base / first parent | κ | binding b |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| #699 (jeremykothe2) | `03e8d7ca494a083e5053cd6b1228f66b98414479` | `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60` | `0.001660666354374641` | complex `0.001663428754540205730067` |
| #685 (chafreaky) | `5fc2a0c4e10558f09f03a8e42559dcf8e381e57e` | `17ce0c79b7b51c2634b439ea5a2b754f09909693` | `0.001660339298410333` | complex `0.001663100609709845015347` |

Both records use the #589 bit supplier, c = `0.001733427039589844234749`.

**Base commit:** `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`

**Reproduce (one command, about 71 min on Linux, Python 3.13.7):**

```sh
PYTHON=/path/to/python-with-numpy bash research/pr-record699-685-audit/replay.sh /tmp/new-output-dir
```

The command ended with exit code 0. It does the following:
* Freshly constructs and replays both packages. This includes #699's strict global admission and two-engine outer-47 price, and all 20 stages of #685's `verify.sh`.
* Runs `independent_check.py`, which imports no repository code. It recounts frames and ranks from the raw gates, replays the exact rational scalar maps and Horner invoices, and checks the literal 72×504 owner maps. It also brackets b and c strictly within 10⁻²⁴ with its own rational log/exp enclosures and recomputes the κ grid point. It confirms that SW4 leaves #699's end-of-B map unchanged on all 728 columns, and that #699 and #685 occupy the same 36,288 physical slots.
* Rejects these negative controls: b ± 2·10⁻²⁴, κ + 10⁻¹⁸, and one moved owner offset.

The standalone #589 bit-circuit pipeline (`research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/tune/verify.sh`, with Boost) was also replayed separately. It reproduces the `nine` record in both PRs' byte-identical `PR589-EXPECTED.json`.

#699 has since gained `f042731`. It changes only the package README and MANIFEST, fixing the PLAN/OWNERS wording noted in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/699#issuecomment-6138514968. The audit stays pinned to `03e8d7c`.

**Credit:** This audit builds on Jeremy Kothe's #699 and his #659/#676 line, and on Chafik Boukhalfa's #685. It also builds on icekylinx's #645, #664's promotions, PR635's local compiler/auditors and eumemic's merged #589. Their notices and credits are retained.

**Scope:** This is a finite replay. The inherited all-size, hosting, precision and analytic-transfer assumptions remain open. It is not a formal verification of the multiplication theorem, and it makes no packing-optimality claim.

**License / AI disclosure:** Apache-2.0. This audit was prepared with substantial AI assistance through Mux (OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5).
